requirements.quote: Two disagreeing sources produce one conflict card; agreeing sources raise confidence.
Adapter health reports the conflict rate per source.
`packages/core/src/facts/agreement.ts`: for each fact, the set of sources, agreement status (agree, conflict, single source) and a confidence score.
A conflict card generalised to every source pair; the lawyer resolves, and the resolution is kept.
`apps/web`: a confidence chip on dates and stages, with the sources listed on hover.
Metrics: the conflict rate per source, which feeds adapter health.

deliverables.change: Pure assessAgreement(observations) -> {sources, status: agree|conflict|single, confidence}; plus getNextDateAgreement reader over a proceeding's listings (provenance sourceType/sourceRef/confidence)
Public barrel for the facts domain
Add facts domain dependency edges (matter-graph if reader uses it)
Register facts exports in SERVICE_TESTS or NOT_A_SERVICE
Generalise card to N sources/every source pair, still never preselecting; resolution via existing chooseNextDateSource path
Expose agreement (status, confidence, sources) on the overview view models
Confidence chip on next date (and stage where shown) with sources on hover
New strings for chip/card (and kn/ta + generated copies per i18n catalog rules)

Security-definer app_staff_conflict_rate(since) mirroring 0072: per-source counts of listings/proposals vs corrected conflicts, staff only (renumbered to 0082 after base took 0080 and 0081; regenerate snapshot)
Show conflict rate per source in adapter health
Cover the new staff function (refuses non-staff, per-source counts only)

preserve.what: chooseNextDateSource semantics: a person chooses, loser stays as `corrected` history (packages/core/src/matter-graph/next-date.ts)
proposeNextDate/confirmNextDate remain the only writers of listing.list_date/canonical (no-direct-listing-update architecture test)
getAdapterHealthSummary and sourceOpsOverview existing fields and callers (packages/core/src/court/adapter-health.ts, packages/core/src/sources/ops.ts, apps/admin data-ops page)
Staff console aggregates stay content-free: no workspace, party or URL data leaves ops.ts

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/core exec vitest run src/facts src/matter-graph/__tests__/next-date.test.ts src/sources/__tests__/ops.test.ts src/__tests__/domains.test.ts

decisions.choice: Reuse listing provenance and the `corrected` state as the kept resolution instead of a new tenant table
decisions.justification: Avoids RLS/seeder registry churn; next-date.ts:13-17 already keeps the losing proposal as corrected history

decisions.choice: Staff conflict-rate via a security-definer function like app_staff_parse_yield
decisions.justification: packages/db/migrations/0072_staff_parse_yield.sql and packages/core/src/sources/ops.ts:118 give the cross-tenant, content-free pattern
